menu.note: The truck's banner reads “Halal | Gluten Free | Dairy Free | Vegan” without saying which dishes; only the halal claim is carried on every dish.

items.name: Mie Goreng Beef Rendang
items.desc: Stir-fried noodles, beef rendang, spices, vegetables, sweet soya sauce and crunchy shallot. Mild or spicy.

tagNotes.contains-gluten: The menu says “soya sauce” — soy sauce is brewed with wheat.
